summary: Doug Collins, an Air Force Reserve chaplain, represented Georgia in the House from 2013 to 2021 and, as the top Republican on the Judiciary Committee, led Trump's defense in the 2019 impeachment. He finished third in Georgia's 2020 Senate special election. The Senate confirmed him as veterans affairs secretary 77–23 in February 2025.
